description: Address second-round review issues: JWT validation in serverless, import path fix, rate limiting, and period over-fetching
steps: Move getJwtSecret() call to module level in packages/backend/src/lib/jwt.ts so it executes on first import
Fix api/index.ts import path to use .ts extension for @vercel/node compatibility
Install express-rate-limit and add rate limiting to auth routes (5 attempts/min/IP)
Simplify GET /api/periods to return only period metadata (id, name, createdAt) without eager subject loading
acceptance_criteria: JWT secret is validated at module load time, crashing serverless cold start if missing
Auth routes have rate limiting (5 attempts per minute per IP on login/register)
GET /api/periods returns only period metadata without subjects/components/grades
